(2) She points her fingers upward; two circular image overlays appear showing skin pores and dark circles under eyes with descriptive text. (3) She opens her palms to the sides; four text boxes with ingredient names appear at the bottom. (4) The scene cuts to her pointing up again; two new circular images showing stretch marks and fine lines appear. (5) She gestures with open palms; three ingredient text boxes appear below. (8) The video cuts to a final white screen with the brand logo and name in Chinese and English.
